items.title: Canonical Next runtime and static rollback
items.whatProves: Next is the local canonical runtime, the static runtime remains the rollback, 23 public routes and 31 API contracts are declared, and feature flags default off.
items.whatDoesNotProve: Public deployment, production traffic, or production operational readiness.
items.scopeLimits: Local/release-candidate runtime only.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Revalidate whenever runtime-source digest, route inventory, or deployment state changes.

items.title: Immutable static visual baselines
items.whatProves: The 72 protected screenshots and 12 desktop DOM snapshots still verify through recovery:verify.
items.whatDoesNotProve: Real-user usability, accessibility conformance, or later owner-approved visual quality.
items.scopeLimits: Original protected static runtime and recorded states.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Immutable; owner-approved overlays are additive and do not replace it.

items.title: Owner-approved Next support baselines
items.whatProves: Owner-approved support-route visual and DOM/asset contracts remain unchanged and executable.
items.whatDoesNotProve: All later owner-approved page variations or human accessibility outcomes.
items.scopeLimits: Manifest-listed support routes and viewports.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Additive owner-approved evidence may extend coverage.

items.title: Guided daily spiritual loop
items.whatProves: Ten typed artifacts preserve provenance, status, edits, reversibility, and cross-module continuity without a silent durable write.
items.whatDoesNotProve: That real users understand, value, or complete the loop safely.
items.scopeLimits: Deterministic local contracts and automated flow.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Revalidate if journey state or default page behavior changes.

items.title: Canonical typed TIG service
items.whatProves: Fixed inputs and versions are deterministic; ranking, traversal, explanation, source validation, cache keys, typed fallbacks, read-only behavior, and client boundaries pass.
items.whatDoesNotProve: Real-world recommendation helpfulness or production capacity.
items.scopeLimits: Current deterministic datasets and rulesets.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Revalidate for dataset, ruleset, ranking, or consumer-contract changes.

items.title: Exact WEB Scripture corpus
items.whatProves: The local WEB corpus covers 66 books, 1,189 chapters, 31,103 markers, 31,098 displayable verses, 356/356 locked references, and 17 owner decisions.
items.whatDoesNotProve: Independent PGP verification, all translation needs, or pastoral interpretation quality.
items.scopeLimits: WEB corpus and owner-approved visible quotations.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Any corpus or quotation change requires revalidation.

items.title: Consent-aware continuity and memory
items.whatProves: Purpose-specific consent, authenticated encryption, export/delete, revocation, retention, user isolation, provenance, and content-free logs pass locally.
items.whatDoesNotProve: Managed production identity, KMS, database, backups, disaster recovery, or operator access controls.
items.scopeLimits: Provider-neutral local/test infrastructure.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Requires a new evidence set for production adapters.

items.title: Deterministic Teo Guide orchestration
items.whatProves: Structured local orchestration, source boundaries, safe fallbacks, and explicit write confirmation work without a model.
items.whatDoesNotProve: Live-model quality or production operational behavior.
items.scopeLimits: Deterministic orchestration path.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Supplemented, not replaced, by Prompt 19K live-provider preview evidence.

items.title: Theological safety and 216-cell performance gate
items.whatProves: Gate A passes 64/64 and all 216 local performance cells passed across three runs with the current semantic safety hash.
items.whatDoesNotProve: Production latency, locale completeness, crisis-resource availability in every jurisdiction, or real-user spiritual safety.
items.scopeLimits: Local deterministic evaluation and measured machine environment.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Revalidate when safety policies, fixtures, runtimes, or performance budgets change.

items.title: Funded live-AI preview gate
items.whatProves: Nine fixtures passed; seven bounded provider calls produced strict responses with valid citations; critical and injection cases made zero calls; audited spend stayed below cap.
items.whatDoesNotProve: Current production enablement, production traffic, longitudinal quality, or all model-version behavior.
items.scopeLimits: Prompt 19K preview; reuse is justified only because policy-defined live-AI paths are unchanged at the current HEAD.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Expires on a policy-defined live-AI path, model, provider, or safety-contract change.

items.title: Partitioned hybrid retrieval quality
items.whatProves: Across 28 locked cases, exact accuracy, citation validity, Recall@5/10, trust and consent filtering were 1.0; p95 was 304.2182 ms; leakage and fabricated citations were zero.
items.whatDoesNotProve: Production vector infrastructure, open-ended query performance, multilingual retrieval, or high source precision.
items.scopeLimits: Local 33,563-vector index and locked evaluation set; policy-defined retrieval paths are unchanged.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Expires on policy-defined retrieval path, corpus, embedding model, or locked-set change.

items.title: Prompt 21 release evidence closeout
items.whatProves: At its source commit, 35 commands and 22 artifacts closed Gate C Preview with coverage, performance, security, accessibility, and operations evidence.
items.whatDoesNotProve: Current Gate C status or current source lineage.
items.scopeLimits: Historical source commit only.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Superseded by current release-evidence validation E13.

items.title: Current release-evidence validation
items.whatProves: Gate C Preview is currently blocked: two artifact hashes, 1,083 lineage entries, gate status, and a coarse protected-diff check fail against the ff925572 evidence source.
items.whatDoesNotProve: That immutable visual baselines changed; recovery:verify independently passes them.
items.scopeLimits: Current validation of the historical release bundle; the bundle was not regenerated in Prompt 24.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Replace only with a newly authorized, current-source, passing release-evidence bundle.

items.title: Open development dependency advisory
items.whatProves: One advisory yields nine high findings in development/lint/CI paths; production-only audit has zero high/critical; no waiver or safe supported fix exists.
items.whatDoesNotProve: That the development advisory is harmless or resolved.
items.scopeLimits: Package-lock hash remains the recorded 1edbad08... identity.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Review on advisory, ESLint, minimatch, brace-expansion, or lockfile change.

items.title: Dependency remediation analysis
items.whatProves: Available dependency substitutions were incomplete or peer-invalid and would weaken or break supported tooling.
items.whatDoesNotProve: Permanent unfixability or owner acceptance of the risk.
items.scopeLimits: Analysis at the unchanged package/lock identity.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Reassess when upstream releases or advisory metadata change.

items.title: Accessibility parity debt
items.whatProves: Known inherited focus/aria-hidden and manual assistive-technology, contrast, zoom, and responsive validation gaps are documented rather than hidden.
items.whatDoesNotProve: WCAG conformance or accessibility with real users.
items.scopeLimits: Automated parity and documented manual gaps.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Close only with scoped fixes and manual/assistive evidence.

items.title: User-research pilot status
items.whatProves: A privacy-safe pilot protocol exists and explicitly records that recruitment and sessions have not happened.
items.whatDoesNotProve: Usability, comprehension, spiritual usefulness, pastoral acceptability, or retention.
items.scopeLimits: Plan only; no participant evidence.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Superseded only by ethically collected, reviewed pilot evidence.

items.title: Stabilization status
items.whatProves: Seven days of use, ten meaningful sessions, and incident history are not documented; production operation is false.
items.whatDoesNotProve: That the product is unstable; it proves the stabilization claim lacks evidence.
items.scopeLimits: Documented evidence state.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Replace with a dated stabilization log meeting defined exit criteria.

items.title: Prompt 23 non-destructive inventory and dependency graph
items.whatProves: At ff925572, 3,521 nodes, 10,726 edges, zero unknown classifications, and five pending owner decisions were documented without deletion.
items.whatDoesNotProve: A current-HEAD complete inventory after later approved product, visual, functional, evidence, and local-output changes.
items.scopeLimits: Candidate decisions remain pending; current existence was rechecked, but the graph was not regenerated.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Requires a new authorized current-HEAD inventory before Prompt 23B action.

items.title: Privacy-safe observability architecture
items.whatProves: Allowlisted, consent-gated, content-free events and exporter-failure isolation are specified and pass focused tests.
items.whatDoesNotProve: Production telemetry delivery, alert response, retention enforcement, or operator practice.
items.scopeLimits: Local/in-process implementation and architecture.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Requires production exporter and operations evidence.

items.title: Consent-aware product-value metrics
items.whatProves: Metrics prioritize clarity, voluntary action, continuity, trust, reversibility, and safety without spiritual scoring or raw content.
items.whatDoesNotProve: Any observed user outcome or product-market fit.
items.scopeLimits: Metric definitions and synthetic tests only.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Supplement with consented aggregate pilot evidence.

items.title: Normative theology and product architecture
items.whatProves: Scripture authority, promise levels, humble interpretation, calling discernment, prayer, testimony ownership, crisis boundaries, and pastoral/professional limits are explicit.
items.whatDoesNotProve: Implementation conformance by itself or real-user theological acceptance.
items.scopeLimits: Normative source; implementation claims require executable evidence.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Only an owner-authorized normative revision supersedes it.

items.title: Cost controls and measured paid evidence
items.whatProves: Per-request admission, token budgets, retry limits, content-free cost metadata, and kill switches exist; Prompt 19K and 20 stayed under approved caps.
items.whatDoesNotProve: Production unit economics, real-user usage distribution, or monthly budget behavior.
items.scopeLimits: Local preview and bounded evaluation evidence.
items.expiresOrSupersedes: Recalculate for model pricing, context shape, traffic, or retry-policy changes.
